        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.driverId ORDER BY ra.date DESC) as rn
    FROM rows r
    LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.driverId = q.driverId
    LEFT JOIN races ra ON q.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE ra.date < r.date 
        AND ra.date >= r.date - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
recent_positions AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        date,
        position,
        race_date,
        rn
    FROM recent_races
    WHERE rn <= 4
),
position_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        date,
        AVG(CASE WHEN rn <= 2 THEN position END) as last_two_avg,
        AVG(CASE WHEN rn > 2 THEN position END) as prev_two_avg
    FROM recent_positions
    GROUP BY driverId, date
)
SELECT 
    pg.driverId,
    pg.date,
    (pg.prev_two_avg - pg.last_two_avg) as improvement_trend
FROM position_groups pg
WHERE pg.last_two_avg IS NOT NULL AND pg.prev_two_avg IS NOT NULL
